added.statement: Dotfiles shall use Codex native bootstrap and retire its custom standalone daemon service and timer; the migrated devbox shall run the native production package at the installed CLI version.
acceptance_criteria: Native bootstrap remains declared in dotfiles activation after legacy service retirement
Legacy daemon and refresh timer are stopped and disabled
CLI, managed package, running server versions agree at migration
Remote control remains enabled and the guardian stays masked

ears.trigger: the operator applies the native daemon migration
ears.response: retire the old systemd daemon/timer and bootstrap the native managed daemon with remote control enabled

breaker.condition: an old systemd unit continues owning the daemon or native package version diverges from the running process at migration
